description: This file defines a configuration class 'Config' for Confluence export functionality within the Daux documentation generator. It provides methods to retrieve and set various configuration options related to Confluence pages and credentials.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration handler for Confluence export settings, extending the BaseConfig class.

methods.name: shouldAutoDeleteOrphanedPages
methods.description: Determines whether orphaned pages should be automatically deleted.

methods.name: shouldPrintDiff
methods.description: Checks if the diff should be printed during operations.

methods.name: getUpdateThreshold
methods.description: Retrieves the threshold value for updates.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Gets the prefix used for Confluence pages.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for the Confluence instance.

methods.name: hasAncestorId
methods.description: Checks if an ancestor ID is configured.

methods.name: hasRootId
methods.description: Checks if a root ID is configured.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header is configured.

methods.name: createRootIfMissing
methods.description: Determines whether to create a root page if missing.
